    "May lack advanced customization options or specialized features found in competitors.",
    "Could feel less feature-rich compared to AI-powered alternatives in the market."

  "overall_experience": "As a Solution Architect in an outsourcing firm, this person likely found Basecamp to be a straightforward and reliable tool for managing projects and facilitating team collaboration. They appreciated its simplicity and ability to keep all project-related communication and documentation in one place, which is crucial for coordinating offshore teams. While effective for core project management, they might have noticed its limitations in advanced features or extensive customization compared to some competitors, especially for complex architectural solution planning."
